entities.summary: Kushan Empire, a political institution in Tajikistan during Greco-Bactrian and Kushan Kingdoms (125 BCE–425). Grew from Alexander and Greco-Bactrian Kingdom and Greco-Bactrian Kingdom. Led to the emergence of Kushan Empire and Buddhism and Kushan.
